text: When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us, is, that they generally differ much more from each other, than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature. When we behold the individuals of our cultivated plants and animals, we find that they differ very much from each other. The middle sizes are rarely found, and the extremes are common.
handwritten_text:
When we look to the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals, one of the first points which strikes us,
is,
that they generally differ much more from each other,
than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature.

When we behold the individuals of our cultivated plants and animals,
we find that they differ very much from each other.

The middle sizes are rarely found,
and the extremes are common.
